title: Teachers’ union gathering outside M’sila Education Directorate
location: Outside the Education Directorate in M’sila wilaya; FIDH/OMCT says two union leaders were arrested about 30 km from the gathering.
scope: Local gathering; no national extent established.
organizer: Coalition of education-sector teachers’ unions; Maghreb Emergent names CNAPESTE, CELA and Syndicat Majal; full coalition not specified.
threshold_50_evidence: Two opened accounts identify a peaceful/national teachers-union gathering before the M’sila Education Directorate but neither provides attendance. “Many teachers” prevented from entering the city is not assembly turnout; >=50 remains unresolved.

title.summary: Both opened reports describe the teachers’ union gathering before M’sila Education Directorate on 24 February; Maghreb Emergent dates publication 19:02 that day.

start_date.summary: FIDH/OMCT dates the gathering 24 February. Maghreb Emergent reports a gathering during continuing strike activity on Feb. 23 and 24; whether this was one continuous gathering or distinct meetings is unknown.

location.summary: Both place the gathering before the Education Directorate in M’sila wilaya. FIDH/OMCT says two union leaders were arrested about 30 km away.

scope.summary: A specific local M’sila gathering is supported; Maghreb Emergent calls it a national gathering of unions but no countrywide physical gathering is established.

organizer.summary: FIDH/OMCT says a coalition of teachers’ unions; Maghreb Emergent names CNAPESTE, CELA and Syndicat Majal.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: Neither opened report gives a headcount or crowd-size description. “Many teachers” blocked from entering M’sila is not the gathering’s attendance.

state_response.summary: FIDH/OMCT reports arrests of two union leaders about 30 km away, police questioning, release and judicial control; Maghreb Emergent reports security preventing teachers from entering M’sila, encircling CNAPESTE offices and eyewitness-attributed arrests. These provide reported arrests and gathering access obstruction; physical dispersal of those assembled is not established.

demands.summary: Neither reviewed passage states participants’ specific demands at the gathering.

notes: One retrospective joint FIDH/OMCT declaration and one contemporary Maghreb Emergent report describe the M’sila gathering; independence of their underlying reporting is not established. Attendance and demands remain unknown. Maghreb Emergent reports strike/gathering activity on Feb 23–24, but physical continuity versus separate meetings is unresolved. FIDH/OMCT places arrests ~30km from the gathering. No national-to-local split is inferred. CIVICUS’s later update repeats the M’sila details with an explicit citation to Maghreb Emergent, so it is a relay, not an independent confirmation.
open_questions: Did the gathering have at least 50 participants?
What were the participants’ stated demands and state target?
Were arrests of union leaders and city-entry restrictions a direct state response to the gathering, given that at least two leaders were about 30 km away?
Did the Feb. 23–24 reports describe one continuous assembly or separate meetings?
What was the gathering’s physical end time and any further state response?
Can a permitted, independently sourced contemporaneous report corroborate attendance or demands?
Is this gathering part of a distinct union campaign or the broader teacher work-stoppage episode?
